selection_status: Recorded before computing any Step 4 run; outcomes known at this point are only case 0/1/2 at noise 0 (Steps 1-3)
question: Is the locally amplified modal direction stable across the existing dataset and saved noise realizations, and does it dominate the saved noisy wrench errors there?
selected_case_ids: All 50 case IDs stored in gt_data/kirchhoff_gt_dataset.npz
noise_dependence: Existing generator broadcasts each realization across cases; there are five noise patterns in total, each shared by all 50 cases. Runs are not 250 independent noise trials.
runners: Committed Step 3 diagnose_recovered.py and diagnose_sensitivity.py, byte-unchanged; no production, data or estimator change
settings: Order (2,2,1), gamma 10, sigma 0.5 deg, alpha 1.0, 30 static EKF updates, three fixed offline starts selected by orientation-residual cost only; identical to Steps 1-3
amplified_direction_definition: At A, v* = normalized pinv(H_s) r1, where r1 is the top right singular vector of the saved total_response_operator J_x pinv(H_s). v* maximizes ||J_x v|| / ||H_s v|| and is used instead of an individual H singular vector because the two weakest H singular values are nearly equal. Sign is fixed by making the largest-magnitude entry positive. Coordinates are the curvature-L2 q coordinates of Step 2.
reference_direction: Principal eigenvector of the mean of v* v*^T over the 50 cases at noise 0; all eigenvalues are reported to show whether one direction or a larger subspace is needed
case_stability_rule: Descriptive: the direction is called consistent across cases if at least 90% of the 50 cases at noise 0 have |cos(v*, reference)| >= 0.9
noise_stability_report: Per case, minimum over noise 1-4 of |cos| between v* and that case's noise-0 v*
error_dominance_rule: Descriptive: in a run, the direction dominates the saved EKF wrench error if |cos| between the actual A-to-D scaled wrench change and J_x v* is >= 0.9. Report the fraction over all valid runs, and the same for C. Also report the Step 3 largest-gain-H-direction share and cosine for continuity.
aggregate_report: Distributions of C and D force error and force-direction error, the maximum response gain at A, and scaled H condition, over all valid runs and per noise realization. Compared with the manuscript only descriptively.
threshold_scope: Thresholds 0.9 and 90% are descriptive choices fixed before the runs, not statistical or physical significance
failures: A run whose runner exits nonzero (including rank or derivative assertion failures) is preserved and counted as unavailable; no replacement cases, new noise draws, extra starts, tuning, or changed rcond
storage: Full per-run outputs are written outside the repository. A compact per-run extraction with the SHA256 of each full result is committed; full outputs are reproducible from the committed runners.
scope_limit: Exact tendon tensions, routing and stiffness; one sensor layout; local linear analysis at A. No remedy is tested in this step.
